body:
Claude Code auto-mode classifier calls share the conversation ID. They must answer independently while the main conversation keeps its checkpoint, session mapping, routing affinity, recovery grant and cancellation authority. This incorporates #1211 with separate maintainer corrections for checkpoint/fallback fences, private auxiliary cancellation leaves, priority affinity, source-evidenced classifier detection and independent retry accounting.

All five actual Noah Passalacqua commits retain Author/AuthorDate; source-to-incorporated mappings are in [the author ledger](https://github.com/rynfar/meridian/blob/cd8b5063a1e001f61eb610f82c05e8bd6e20974a/docs/maintenance/evidence/1211-claude-auxiliary-20261004/author-ledger.json). The earlier API hold was an overbroad inference from internal TypeScript exports; these adapter hooks are outside the published package interface. This approves no other public proposal.

Validation at clean `80d1ce8158dc7cd466a87863404bf6ea02754c8b`: `npm test` passes all 19 stages (5,417 pass / 35 skips / 0 failures; 27,544 assertions), standalone typecheck and build pass. Final delivery adds maintenance evidence only; all 19 executable/instruction hashes remain identical. Source `22566e8a` was refreshed unchanged, open and without comments/reviews. Complete independent source, production, harness and cancellation-settlement reviews found no remaining material findings. A separate read-only delivery review verified all 110 artifact hashes, 64 original/archive pairs, 19 harness originals, the raw results from all 19 test stages, all five preserved author/date mappings and the 14 maintenance-only delivery paths. It confirms the native and CI holds remain open.

[Durable evidence](https://github.com/rynfar/meridian/blob/cd8b5063a1e001f61eb610f82c05e8bd6e20974a/docs/maintenance/evidence/1211-claude-auxiliary-20261004/README.md) includes causal before/after checkpoint, cancellation, affinity, XML/classifier and idle controls; 19 synthetic harness controls; original failures; 64 original/gzip archive pairs and a 110-artifact checksum manifest. The first full stage's body-cancellation settlement failure is retained; the reviewed test-only correction observes real finalizer retirement before every original survival assertion. The older shutdown fixture now fences non-subject auth/default-store/CLI boundaries. A mocked SDK alone does not establish all auth-store isolation, and no earlier real refresh is inferred.

Follow-up evidence review found a missing requested-model witness in the published E71 harness: synthetic controls could keep the correct served ID while providing a wrong requested wire/SDK ID or missing/wrong alias pin. The correction is in progress. The pinned native client selects its classifier model separately from the main request, so that dialect must be resolved before freezing the new witness. Existing local results above apply to the published head; no new native acceptance is claimed.

Keep this draft until exact-head CI, including test, and actual Linux x64 Claude Code/target-installed SDK/native CLI/exact served Sonnet E71 pass. E55 gateway parity and all four E41 chain/parallel × stream/nonstream modes remain gates; any OpenCode proof must use the actual Meridian plugin. Synthetic controls, static distribution inspection and historical `sonnet` alias observations do not supply missing native proof. Source PRs/issues stay open; no release is authorized.
